_meta.note: Canonical MOSAIC living-landscape boundaries, simplified for the catalogue locator map (world view + click-to-zoom). Derived from MOSAIC_catalog/boundaries/<CODE>.geojson (approved delineations, 2026-07-21; EPSG:4326). Per code: 'd' is an SVG path in the locator projection x = lon + 180, y = 90 - lat, rounded to 3 decimals, rings subsampled to <= 500 vertices; 'bbox' is the projected [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the full-resolution geometry (the zoom target). Render with fill-rule='evenodd'. Regenerate with scripts/build_map_outlines.py.
